name: Best available rate - Bed and breakfast
description: Enjoy a comfortable stay at our hotel and start each day with a delicious breakfast. Book at our best available rate. Free cancellation is possible up to 1 day before arrival.
cancellationPolicy:
Refundable rate: Your credit card is required as a guarantee only and will not be charged, provided that you cancel your reservation within the permitted cancellation period. The hotel must receive your cancellation notice at least 1 day before the scheduled arrival date. In case of late cancellation or no-show, a fee equal to 100% of the first night's stay will be charged.

Please note that the exchange rate applied by the hotel may differ from the exchange rate offered by your bank. Credit card payments will be charged in CZK. Any exchange rate differences are non-refundable.

name: Pay in Advance with Breakfast – Save 10%
description: Save 10% on your stay with breakfast included. This special rate requires 100% payment in advance. The payment is non-refundable and is related to accommodation and breakfast only. Any other extras will be paid directly in the hotel.
cancellationPolicy:
Non-refundable Rate: The total cost of your reservation will be charged on the day of booking and is non-refundable. In the event of cancellation, changes to the reservation, or a no-show, the full cost of the stay will be charged.
The charge covers accommodation (including VAT) and any other services included in your reservation at the time of booking. Additional service is not included in the original reservation can be paid for at the hotel.

Please note that the exchange rate applied by the hotel may differ from the exchange rate offered by your bank. Credit card payments will be charged in CZK. Any exchange rate differences are non-refundable.
